posts.title: 5MPH of Pure Adrenaline: Cruising Disney Springs in an Amphicar
posts.teaser: A 1960s car, a ramp and Lake Buena Vista. Cruising Disney Springs in an Amphicar at a blistering 5mph, plus how to knock $25 off.
posts.standfirst: Forget Test Track. Forget Rock ’n’ Roller Coaster. There’s a new high-speed thrill ride in Orlando, and it tops out at a blistering 5mph.
posts.dek: Rob Callery cruises Disney Springs in a vintage Amphicar from The BOATHOUSE: what it costs, how to save $25 by eating first, PhotoPass and Memory Maker, and whether it is worth it.
